newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha drops in corrective move.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha drops in corrective move.

text.p: NWE naphtha dropped on Wednesday despite stronger crude. Activity remained very thin with a number of key players out of the market because of industry functions connected with IP week in London.
The market came off on news of an Italian 71 paraffinic 25,000 tonne cargo selling today at $216 cif Antwerp arriving by the end of February.
"Naphtha has been due for a correction. The back end of the month usually gets sold, but it will probably pick up again," said one dealer.
